items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I used to have every record Bunny Berigan ever made ‘cause he was my hero, when I was growing up, that’s the guy I thought was the great trumpet player

ctx.x: No, he wasn’t lead trumpet player; he was a jazz trumpet player and one of the most beautiful jazz trumpet players I ever heard. He was kind of a Bunny Berigan type of player except more modern and lived pretty much the same kind of lifestyle too.
With the same kind of end?
